description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Canvas_Color' which extends the 'Image_Color' class. It provides methods for color allocation, conversion, range generation, and internal color setting, all within an image processing context. The class is tailored for color handling in image manipulation tasks, extending existing functionality with additional color processing features.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_Color
classes.description: A class that extends 'Image_Color' to handle advanced color processing, including RGB/RGBA conversions, alpha transparency handling, and color range generation within images.

methods.name: allocateColor
methods.description: Allocates a color in a given GD image resource, supporting transparency via alpha channel if available.

methods.name: color2RGB
methods.description: Converts a color representation (array or string) into an RGBA array of four integers.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Generates a range of colors between two colors, including alpha channel interpolations.

methods.name: _setColors
methods.description: Internally sets two color properties with proper RGB/RGBA arrays.
